claims.claim: The homepage cards state the same release counts the data files hold.
claims.metric: the two card figures in index.html versus the data
claims.method: compares each card's number with its data file, so the cards cannot drift again (they said 32+ and 12 before 2026-09-12)

claims.claim: The sync workflow is manual: `sync.yml` has no `schedule:` trigger. (The claims gate itself is scheduled weekly; that is this repository's only cron.)
claims.metric: `schedule:` blocks in .github/workflows/sync.yml, plus a count of every workflow that has one
claims.method: the README says the sync is run on demand; this asserts sync.yml stays dispatch-only and reports which workflows are scheduled

claims.claim: scripts/sync.mjs rewrites openclaw_data.js — the file openclaw.html loads.
claims.metric: the path the syncer writes versus the path the page loads
claims.method: both are read out of the committed files; before 2026-09-12 the syncer wrote a block into index.html that did not exist there

claims.claim: A test fails if the homepage cards stop matching the data files.
claims.metric: the test file exists and reads both data files
claims.method: it was added on 2026-09-12 with the card fix; this asserts it is still there and still parses the data

claims.claim: The LICENSE file is the MIT licence (package.json does not declare one; the package is private).
claims.method: read the first line of the committed licence text

claims.claim: The site ships `robots.txt` that allows all crawlers and names the sitemap, and an `llms.txt` summary; neither has been left to rot.
claims.value: robots allows all + declares the sitemap; llms.txt present
claims.metric: presence and content of robots.txt / llms.txt at the site root
claims.method: reads both files: robots.txt must contain 'User-agent: *', 'Allow: /' and a Sitemap line pointing at this site; llms.txt must be non-empty and link this site's pages

check.cmd: python3 -c "import pathlib;r=pathlib.Path('robots.txt').read_text();l=pathlib.Path('llms.txt').read_text();ok=('User-agent: *' in r and 'Allow: /' in r and 'Sitemap: https://alloevil.github.io/agent-changelog/sitemap.xml' in r);ok=ok and len(l)>200 and 'alloevil.github.io/agent-changelog' in l;print('robots+llms ok', ok);assert ok"
